_: Where the weapon hat sits on each gun (tools/roblox/hat_spots.py measures its height and writes roblox/src/shared/GunHatData.luau). z = along the gun (metres, the weapon frame, -z toward the muzzle), x = sideways, s = the hat's size (1 = as built, about 7 cm across), yaw = degrees, pitch = degrees about x after the yaw (90 stands the hat on the back end), sink = how far its foot goes into the surface (default 0.002), y = a fixed height instead of the measured one, saddle = metres the hat stands higher on a slate puck (a round scope or barrel).

ar.note: on the rib over the receiver, between the sights

smg.note: on the receiver ahead of the rear sight

burst.note: on the carry handle, ahead of its three squares

lmg.note: on the feed cover (it rides the cover when it opens)

dmr.note: on the rear of the box optic's flat top, on a saddle (round 5: brims sank into the optic)

sniper.note: on the rear third of the scope, on a saddle tall enough to clear the eyepiece's rise (round 9: 9 mm cut 4 mm into it)

lever.note: on the receiver between the barrel rib and the sight rib (round 4: at -0.06 the sight rib ran through the crown)

shotgun.note: on the slotted barrel shield (round 4: at -0.11 the rear sight block crowded it)

autoshot.note: on the receiver, its whole spin clear of the mower deck ahead and the rear sight behind

sawnoff.note: on the barrels, back from the bead (it tips down with them when the gun breaks open)

pistol.note: on the slide, back from the front sight (it rides the slide)

revolver.note: on the top strap over the cylinder

redline.note: on the raised block over the receiver, on a saddle clear of the gauge's housing (round 9: behind the gauge the bigger hats in third person cut into the block and the rear sight)

marbles.note: on the marble jar's lid (it steps away while the reload pours marbles in: GunHats.HIDE_CLIPS); round 9: behind the jar it sat on the lock beside the hammer

katana.note: on the pommel, standing off the end of the handle (round 4: on the blade it floated beside the edge)

shredder.note: on top of the body behind the bell
